subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the third letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster.

STANZA : HHZNAA :: TEMPLE : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba916a408f3568f84437c9f1aea31af04580a322625d603d1d1cfe28d80cf146.png] 

The logic followed here is:-

Odd positions letters of given word STANZA are given opposite alphabet and Even position letters of given word are opposite alphabet +1. 

 
• Odd position ⇔** ****opposite alphabet**
 
• **Even Position **⇔ opposite alphabet + 1

STANZA : HHZNAA

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11ee5fb4457fca2a5c6767ea9d62ab55ac7226f7b2e1f18968f33f7fb91186fd.png] 

Similarly,

Code : Odd positions letters of given word TEMPLATE are given opposite alphabet and Even position letters of given word are opposite alphabet +1.

TEMPLE : GWNLOW 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e526edcb3e8beeec6a001a59173040b0341c5f1d5994cbd848df8cfe9268223.png] 

Thus, the correct answer is "GWNLOW".
